en.title: Try this three-sentence script
en.intro: Use this same script through the steps below. Download the TXT file to your iPhone or iPad, then import it in Oralo, or paste the text into a new script.
en.note: The screenshots use this English practice script. Labels identify each captured version and environment. Simulator images demonstrate the interface; they are not physical microphone tests.
paragraphs: Today I’ll share a short update on our project.
This week, we completed the first draft and reviewed the feedback.
Next, we will test the changes and confirm the plan on Friday.

zh.title: 先用这份三句示例练习
zh.intro: 下面的步骤都使用这份讲稿。在 iPhone 或 iPad 上下载 TXT 文件后导入 Oralo，也可以将正文粘贴到新讲稿中。
zh.note: 截图保留了拍摄时的原始讲稿，与这份练习稿不同。每张图均标明记录版本和环境；模拟器界面截图不代表真机收音测试。
paragraphs: 今天，我来汇报一下项目进展。
本周，我们完成了第一版草稿，并整理了反馈。
接下来，我们会测试修改，并在周五确认计划。
